fields.description: Series used to number new Style Masters, e.g. STY-.YYYY.-.#### gives STY-2026-0001. Existing styles keep their names.
fields.label: Style Naming Series

fields.description: Pre-filled as the rate on a Manufacturing Cost row when it is based on SMV.
fields.label: Default Style Rate

fields.description: Pre-filled as the efficiency on a new SMV row.
fields.label: Default Efficiency

fields.description: Copied into Other Cost on every new Style Master.
fields.label: Default Cost Heads

fields.description: Adds a workflow to Style Master: Draft → Costed → Approved → Quoted. A Merchandiser marks a style Costed; a Costing Manager approves it, sends it back, marks it Quoted or cancels it. While this is on, the workflow buttons replace Submit and Cancel.
fields.label: Enable Costing Approval Workflow

fields.description: Records created by Install Demo Data, so Remove Demo Data deletes exactly those.
fields.label: Installed Demo Records

fields.description: Tell the app which of your Item Groups hold fabric, trims and finished goods. A group listed here covers every group beneath it. On a style, the Fabric and Trims lists and the Style Name list offer items from these groups only.
fields.label: Item Groups
